response.sql: SELECT c.code, c.name_th, p.requires, p.kind, CASE WHEN pi.code IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS in_selected_plan, COALESCE(COALESCE(e.status, CASE WHEN p.requires IS NOT NULL THEN 'recorded_requirement' ELSE 'unknown' END), 'unknown') AS prerequisite_status, COALESCE(e.source_file, p.source_file, c.source_file) AS source_file, COALESCE(e.page_number, p.page_number, c.page_number) AS page_number, e.printed_page_number AS printed_page_number FROM course c LEFT JOIN prerequisite p ON p.code = c.code LEFT JOIN course_prerequisite_evidence e ON e.code = c.code LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT code FROM plan_item) pi ON pi.code=c.code WHERE c.code = '06026113' LIMIT 100

response.sql: SELECT c.code, c.name_th, p.requires, p.kind, CASE WHEN pi.code IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS in_selected_plan, COALESCE(COALESCE(e.status, CASE WHEN p.requires IS NOT NULL THEN 'recorded_requirement' ELSE 'unknown' END), 'unknown') AS prerequisite_status, COALESCE(e.source_file, p.source_file, c.source_file) AS source_file, COALESCE(e.page_number, p.page_number, c.page_number) AS page_number, e.printed_page_number AS printed_page_number FROM course c LEFT JOIN prerequisite p ON p.code = c.code LEFT JOIN course_prerequisite_evidence e ON e.code = c.code LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT code FROM plan_item) pi ON pi.code=c.code WHERE c.code = '06026113' LIMIT 100
